ValidationRule.description: For amendment quotes, the end date of the quote line cannot be changed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Type__c) = 'Amendment', TEXT(SBQQ__Product__r.SBQQ__SubscriptionType__c) != 'One-Time', TEXT(SBQQ__Product__r.Product_Type__c) != 'Training', SBQQ__ProductCode__c <> 'TAN-PREM-ESR-MONTHLY', SBQQ__ProductCode__c <> 'TAN-PREM-ESR-1D/W', SBQQ__ProductCode__c <> 'TAN-PREM-ESR-TIER1-1D/M', SBQQ__ProductCode__c <> 'TAN-PREM-ESR-TIER2-1D/M', SBQQ__ProductCode__c <> 'TAN-PREM-ESR-TIER3-1D/M', SBQQ__ProductCode__c <> 'TAN-PREM-ESR', ISCHANGED(SBQQ__EndDate__c), SBQQ__EndDate__c != PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__EndDate__c), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The End Date of an Amendment quote line can't be changed since it needs to align to the End Date of the amended contract
